description.value: Pomme Natural Market is a 100% BC-owned natural grocery chain with its original and largest location in Port Coquitlam, repeatedly voted #1 grocery, health/organic food, and vitamin store in the Tri-Cities A-List. The store stocks certified organic and local spray-free produce, all-natural groceries, vitamins and supplements, eco-friendly home goods, and a deli offering fresh ready-to-eat meals and snacks. It is a strong resupply option for touring cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway corridor.
